resources.string: The tool is off. Turn it on, then connect your Home Assistant.
Enter your Home Assistant\'s address, or pick one found on this network.
Not signed in. Sign in with your browser, or paste an access token.
Signed in to %1$s. The keyboard connects when you open the tool.
Home Assistant stopped accepting the keyboard\'s key. Sign in again.
%1$s is not answering. Check the address, or try the remote one.
The keyboard talks only to the server you name here, with a key Home Assistant issues to it. Nothing passes through any other service.
Lights, switches, climate, media, scenes and sensors as tiles in the keyboard, live
Tap one to use its address
Looking for Home Assistant on this network…
None announced itself yet. Type the address instead.
Falls back to the remote address when the home one does not answer
Your browser opens Home Assistant\'s own login page. The keyboard gets a key, never your password.
Signed in through the browser. The key renews itself.
Signed in with a long-lived access token.
The sign-in did not match the one started here. Try again.
No server address to sign in to.
In Home Assistant: your profile, Security tab, Long-lived access tokens, Create token. Paste it here; it is kept only on this phone.
Pick the tiles the Favourites tab shows, and hide what you never use
Your Home Assistant areas, in its order. Off, there is Favourites and All.
Locks, alarms, garage doors, gates and sirens take a hold instead of a tap
The command bar at the bottom of the panel sends what you type to Home Assistant\'s Assist, which understands sentences like \"turn off the kitchen lights\".
Type a sentence for your home at the bottom of the panel
Which of your assistants answers. The list comes from the server once connected.
Assist answers in the language you are typing in
The connection is a WebSocket the keyboard holds open so tiles change the moment the house does. It costs little, but it is a connection.
Connects when you open the tool and drops a minute after you leave it.
Connects when the keyboard comes up, so the panel is live the instant it opens; drops a minute after the keyboard hides.
Keep the last states on the phone
The panel draws your tiles at once from the last session, dimmed until the server confirms them
Let the AI chat control your home
The chat\'s tools include your home; each one asks before it acts
\"turn off the lights\" in any field offers a chip that does it instead of sending the words
The Favourites tab shows these, in this order. Drag to reorder; the bin takes one off the tab without hiding it.
No favourites yet. Star anything below.
Hidden tiles stay out of every tab and out of search. Tap one to bring it back.
Whole kinds of entity the panel never lists.
Nothing from your Home Assistant yet. Open the tool once while connected, or check the connection on the tool\'s page.
Turns things on or off, sets brightness or temperature, runs scenes, through Home Assistant\'s Assist. Only listed while the Home Assistant tool is signed in.
The states of your devices and sensors, as Home Assistant has them now
